package.name: rover_drive
package.description: The rover's drive command path, everything between the operators and the swerve controller: twist_mux (which cmd_vel_* input drives), the drive manager (switches the RoverHardware component and the swerve controller together, compact mode, clearing drive faults, publishes drive/state) and the tower lamp showing whether an autonomous or a manual source is driving. Used by the onboard joystick and the ground station alike; runs on the rover in hardware and in simulation.
